widget.name: Date Picker Pro
widget.description: Date and date range picker with presets, event markers and typed shortcuts.

property.caption: Selection type
property.description: Pick one date, or a start and an end date.

property.caption: Date attribute
property.description: The attribute the picked date is saved to.

property.caption: Start date attribute
property.description: The attribute the start of the range is saved to.

property.caption: End date attribute
property.description: The attribute the end of the range is saved to.

property.caption: Save range end as
property.description: The time saved with the end of a range when no time is shown. End of period suits filters such as [Date] <= $End.

property.caption: Time zone handling
property.description: Automatic follows the attribute's Localize setting in the domain model.

property.caption: Date format
property.description: Date, Time and Date and time use the user's language settings. Month, Quarter and Year show a picker for that period.

property.caption: Month format
property.description: How months are written.

property.caption: Custom date format
property.description: Uses the formatDateTime symbols, plus QQQ for quarters, for example dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm or yyyy QQQ. The picker follows the pattern: no day means a month, quarter or year picker.

property.caption: Time interval
property.description: Minutes between the options in the time list.

property.caption: Time caption
property.description: Heading above the time list.

property.caption: Typing
property.description: Segmented fields fill in separators as you type and work with every format. Free text reads the whole date when the field loses focus.

property.caption: Relative typing
property.description: Let users type shortcuts like t (today), +7d, next fri or last month. The help popup lists them.

property.caption: Placeholder
property.description: Text shown in an empty field or button. For ranges, this is the start field.

property.caption: End placeholder
property.description: Text shown in an empty end field.

property.caption: Invalid character message
property.description: Shown when a typed character doesn't fit the format. Leave empty to show nothing.

property.caption: Include invalid character
property.description: Add the rejected character to the message.

property.caption: Show as
property.description: Input: typeable date fields. Button: a button showing the date or range, as in a dashboard toolbar. Inline: the calendar shown on the page.

property.caption: Show icon
property.description: Show the calendar icon.

property.caption: Custom icon
property.description: Replaces the calendar icon.

property.caption: Clearable
property.description: Show a clear button, and let users empty the field by typing.

property.caption: Read-only style
property.description: How the widget looks when it can't be edited.

property.caption: Months to display
property.description: How many months show side by side. 0 shows 1 for single dates and 2 for ranges.

property.caption: Show previous months
property.description: Show the months before the current one instead of after it.

property.caption: Week numbering
property.description: ISO weeks start on Monday, and week 1 holds the first Thursday of the year.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Follow the first day of the week

property.caption: Show days of other months
property.description: Fill the first and last week with days of the neighboring months, dimmed.

property.caption: Alignment
property.description: Which edge of the field the popup lines up with. It flips when there isn't room.

property.caption: Show arrow
property.description: Show a small arrow pointing at the field.

property.caption: Mobile breakpoint
property.description: Below this screen width (in pixels) the popup shows one month, with presets as chips, across the bottom of the screen.

property.caption: Shortcuts help
property.description: Where the button that explains the typing and keyboard shortcuts appears.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Beside the field and in the popup

property.caption: Custom help content
property.description: Replace the built-in help with your own content, for example to translate it.

property.caption: Help content
property.description: Shown in the help popup instead of the built-in list.

property.caption: Show presets
property.description: Show the preset list beside the calendar. Single dates only offer Today, Yesterday and Tomorrow.

property.caption: Today
property.description: Offer today.

property.caption: Yesterday
property.description: Offer yesterday.

property.caption: Tomorrow
property.description: Offer tomorrow.

property.caption: This week
property.description: Offer this week.

property.caption: Last week
property.description: Offer last week.

property.caption: This month
property.description: Offer this month.

property.caption: Last month
property.description: Offer last month.

property.caption: This quarter
property.description: Offer this quarter.

property.caption: Last quarter
property.description: Offer last quarter.

property.caption: This year
property.description: Offer this year.

property.caption: Last year
property.description: Offer last year.

property.caption: All time
property.description: Offer all time.

property.caption: Custom label
property.description: Highlighted when the range was picked by hand.

property.caption: Presets
property.description: Your own presets, such as Last 90 days or Next quarter.

property.caption: Start
property.description: For example addDays([%BeginOfCurrentDay%], -89). Leave empty for no start.

property.caption: End
property.description: Leave empty to use the start (single dates) or no end.

property.caption: Presets from data
property.description: Objects that each add a preset, for example fiscal periods kept in the database.

property.caption: Position
property.description: Where your presets go in the list.

property.caption: Min date
property.description: The earliest date that can be picked (inclusive).

property.caption: Max date
property.description: The latest date that can be picked (inclusive).

property.caption: Mode
property.description: Only these: just the listed days can be picked. All except these: the listed days can't be picked.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: For example a list of holidays.

property.caption: Mode
property.description: Only these: just the days inside the intervals can be picked. All except these: those days can't.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: For example school holidays.

property.caption: Shortest range
property.description: In days, or in months, quarters or years for those formats, counting both ends. Leave empty for no limit.

property.caption: Longest range
property.description: Counting both ends. Leave empty for no limit.

property.caption: Ranges can't include unavailable days
property.description: Refuse ranges that have a day that can't be picked inside them.

property.caption: Min time
property.description: The earliest time that can be picked. Only the time of day is used.

property.caption: Max time
property.description: The latest time that can be picked. Only the time of day is used.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: For example appointments already booked.

property.caption: Time attribute
property.description: Only the time of day is used.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: Objects shown as dots under their day, for example deadlines or events.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Any CSS color, for example '#7c5cfc' or 'var(--brand-danger)'. Leave empty for the accent color.

property.caption: Label
property.description: Shown when hovering the day and read by screen readers.

property.caption: Apply and Cancel
property.description: Automatic shows Apply and Cancel for ranges, so a half-picked range is never saved, and saves single dates on click.

property.caption: Close on select
property.description: Close the popup once a date or range is picked (without Apply and Cancel).

property.caption: Open to date
property.description: The month shown when the popup opens and nothing is picked yet.

property.caption: Use custom content
property.description: Add your own content below the calendar, for example buttons that set the date.

property.caption: Close popup attribute
property.description: Set this Boolean to true, for example from a button in the custom content, to close the popup. The widget sets it back to false.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Runs once each time a new date or range is saved.

property.caption: On enter
property.description: Runs when the popup opens, or when an inline calendar gets focus.

property.caption: On leave
property.description: Runs when the popup closes, or when an inline calendar loses focus.

translations.translation: That isn't a date that can be picked.

property.caption: Range too short message
property.description: [count] is replaced with the shortest length. Studio Pro reserves braces for text template parameters.

property.caption: Range too long message
property.description: [count] is replaced with the longest length. Studio Pro reserves braces for text template parameters.

translations.translation: The range can't include days that are unavailable.

property.caption: Navigate button prefix
property.description: Read before Previous month or Next month.

property.caption: Select prefix
property.description: Read before a day, month or year.

property.caption: Week prefix
property.description: Read before a week number.

property.caption: Month prefix
property.description: Read before a month in the month picker.

property.caption: Disabled label
property.description: Read for days that can't be picked.
